'''Dorothea Fiedler''' is a [[Chemical biology|chemical biologist]] and also the first female director of the [[Leibniz-Forschungsinstitut für Molekulare Pharmakologie]] (Leibniz Research Institute for Molecular Pharmacology, FMP) in [[Berlin|Berlin, Germany]].

== Early life and education ==

Fiedler grew up in [[Hamburg]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.leibniz-fmp.de/press-media/press-releases/press-releases-single-view1/article/dorothea-fiedler-is-a-new-director-at-the-fmp.html|title=FMP Berlin: Dorothea Fiedler is a new director at the FMP|website=www.leibniz-fmp.de|date=2015-07-14|access-date=2019-03-07}}{{Dead link|date=February 2024 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref> She studied inorganic chemistry at the [[University of Würzburg]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.uni-wuerzburg.de/alumni/news-gesichter/alumni-im-portraet/alumni-portraet-single/news/dorothea-fiedler-chemie-humboldt-universitaet-berlin/|title=Dorothea Fiedler, Chemie, Humboldt-Universität Berlin|website=www.uni-wuerzburg.de|language=de|access-date=2019-03-17}}{{Dead link|date=February 2024 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref> then carried out doctorate research on [[organometallic chemistry]] at the [[University of California, Berkeley|University of California at Berkeley]].<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.gdch.de/netzwerk-strukturen/gdch-campus-event/historie/frankfurt-am-main-17-oktober-2018/dorothea-fiedler.htmll|title=Dorothea Fiedler {{!}} Gesellschaft Deutscher Chemiker e.V.|website=www.gdch.de|language=en|access-date=2023-08-26}}</ref>

N.|date=2006-07-19|title=Supramolecular Catalysis of Unimolecular Rearrangements: Substrate Scope and Mechanistic Insights|journal=Journal of the American Chemical /><ref>{{Cite weekly}}</ref> Her research focuses on the synthesis and signalling roles of [[inositol phosphate]]s,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.princeton.edu/chemistry/fiedler/research/|title=Research - Fiedler Group|website=www.princeton.edu|access-date=2019-03-17|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150906001012/http://www.princeton.edu/chemistry/fiedler/research/|archive-date=2015-09-06}}</ref> in diphosphoinositol polyphosphate messengers|journal=Chem. In 2015, Fiedler became the director of the [[Leibniz-Forschungsinstitut für Molekulare Pharmakologie]] as well as a professor of chemistry at the [[Humboldt University of Berlin]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://agnes.hu-berlin.de/lupo/rds?state=verpublish&status=init&vmfile=no&moduleCall=webInfo&publishConfFile=webInfoPerson&keep=y&publishSubDir=personal&personal.pid=27099|title=Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin - Dorothea Fiedler|website=agnes.hu-berlin.de|access-date=2019-03-17}}</ref> She continues developing her research focus on the synthesis and signalling roles of [[Post-translational modification|protein modifications]] involving pyrophosphates,<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Yates|first1=Lisa M.|last2=Fiedler|first2=Dorothea|date=2016-04-15|title=A Stable Pyrophosphoserine Analog for Incorporation into Peptides and Proteins|journal=ACS Chemical Biology|volume=11|issue=4|pages=1066–1073|doi=10.1021/acschembio.5b00972|pmid=26760216|issn=1554-8929}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Marmelstein|first1=Alan M.|last2=Morgan|first2=Jeremy A. M.|last3=Penkert|first3=Martin|last4=Rogerson|first4=Daniel T.|last5=Chin|first5=Jason W.|last6=Krause|first6=Eberhard|last7=Fiedler|first7=Dorothea|date=2018|title=Pyrophosphorylation via selective phosphoprotein derivatization|journal=Chemical Science|volume=9|issue=27|pages=5929–5936|doi=10.1039/C8SC01233D|issn=2041-6520|pmc=6050540|pmid=30079207}}</ref> as well as building collaborations on biological chemistry and catalysis.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.unisyscat.tu-berlin.de/research-units/signal-controlled-multicomponent-catalysis.html|title=UniSysCat: Signal-controlled multicomponent catalysis|website=www.unisyscat.tu-berlin.de|access-date=2019-03-17|archive-date=2021-04-13|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210413074700/https://www.unisyscat.tu-berlin.de/research-units/signal-controlled-multicomponent-catalysis.html}}</ref>

== Funding, service, and awards ==

Fiedler has received a New Innovator Award totalling over $2 million from the [[National Institutes of Health|NIH]] in 2013.<ref>{{Cite journal|url=http://grantome.com/grant/NIH/DP2-CA186753-01|title=Understanding phosphate metabolism in cancer and metastasis|last=Fiedler|first=Dorothea|date=2013|website=Grantome|access-date=2019-03-17}}</ref> She also received funding from the [[Sidney Kimmel#Philanthropy|Sidney Kimmel Foundation for Cancer Research]]<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.prweb.com/releases/Sidney_Kimmel/cancer_research/prweb10774468.htm|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150222123658/http://www.prweb.com/releases/Sidney_Kimmel/cancer_research/prweb10774468.htm|archive-date=February 22, 2015|title=The Sidney Kimmel Foundation for Cancer Research Announces 2013 Grant Recipients|website=PRWeb|access-date=2019-03-17}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://kimmel.org/kimmel-scholars/our-scholars/|title=Our Scholars|website=Sidney Kimmel Foundation|access-date=2019-03-17}}</ref> and the Rita Allen Foundation.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://ritaallen.org/scholar-year/2013/|title=Years 2013 - Rita Allen Foundation|access-date=2019-03-17}}</ref> During her postdoctoral research, she received the [[Ernst Schering Foundation]] Postdoctoral Fellowship, was on the Fastrack Program of the [[Robert Bosch Stiftung|Robert Bosch Foundation]], and obtained an NIH Pathway to Independence Award.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.unisyscat.tu-berlin.de/group-leaders/fiedler-dorothea.html|title=UniSysCat: Fiedler, Dorothea|website=www.unisyscat.tu-berlin.de|access-date=2019-03-17|archive-date=2021-04-13|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210413084808/https://www.unisyscat.tu-berlin.de/group-leaders/fiedler-dorothea.html}}</ref>

Fiedler is an invited speaker at the [[European Molecular Biology Organization|EMBO]] conference on [[Chemical biology|Chemical Biology]] 2016<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.embl.de/training/events/2016/CHB16-01/speakers_gallery/|title=EMBO Conference - Chemical Biology 2016 - Speakers|website=www.embl.de|access-date=2019-03-17}}</ref> and at the International Symposium on [[Bioorganic chemistry|Bioorganic Chemistry]] in 2017.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.uni-konstanz.de/en/isboc-11/programme/speakers/|title=Speakers {{!}} Programme {{!}} International Symposium on Bioorganic Chemistry (ISBOC-11) & Konstanz Symposium Chemical Biology {{!}} University of Konstanz|website=www.uni-konstanz.de|access-date=2019-03-17}}{{Dead link|date=February 2024 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>

Fiedler is one of the local organizers of the 42nd National Organic Chemistry Symposium by the [[American Chemical Society#Division of Organic Chemistry|organic division of the American Chemical Society]] in 2011.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.organicdivision.org/noshistory/|title=- NOS History|website=ACS Division of Organic Chemistry|date=4 November 2016 |access-date=2019-03-17}}</ref>
